The four tables list every atom of one conventional cubic cell of four crystals (files named by crystal). Use the kinematic structure factor with atomic numbers as angle-independent weights and first-order Bragg diffraction; the relevant peak is the lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity. Weights: aluminium nickel: Al = 13, Ni = 28; Nb3 Sn: Nb = 41, Sn = 50; Buckminsterfullerene: C = 6; iron: Fe = 26. For X-rays of wavelength 2.28970 Å, you must choose the crystal whose lowest-angle reflection with non-zero intensity lies closest to 2θ = 46.30° (for example, to calibrate a detector at that angle). Which crystal should you choose?

选项：
A. Nb3 Sn (COD1538281-cell.txt)
B. Buckminsterfullerene (COD9011073-cell.txt)
C. iron (COD9000657-cell.txt)
D. aluminium nickel (COD9008802-cell.txt)

附件：COD9008802-cell.txt、COD1538281-cell.txt、COD9011073-cell.txt、COD9000657-cell.txt（均为本题完整输入）。范围：常规晶胞按 CIF 全部对称操作展开（task_families/cell.py）；周期晶体；衍射题为运动学模型与原子序数权重。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
